sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Single-Origin Green Arabica Coffee Bean Container Distribution

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Taiwan (source jurisdiction for the Taiwan corporate investor; WFOE to be incorporated in Mainland China)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Agreement on the Protection and Promotion of Investment (2012)
Cross-Strait Agreement on the Avoidance of Double Taxation and Enhancement of Tax Cooperation on Income (signed 2015, implemented through respective cross-strait measures)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (effective 1 January 2025); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information (PBOC and SAMR Order No. 3 [2024], effective 1 November 2024); PRC Foreign Investment Law and its Implementing Regulations; PRC Company Law; SAMR Measures for Enterprise Name Registration; as to the Taiwan-source shareholder, Taiwan Money Laundering Control Act, Counter-Terrorism Financing Act, and the Ministry of Economic Affairs Company Registration rules.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Taiwan corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Division
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan is not an Apostille Convention party: Taiwan notarization by a licensed Taiwan notary, then SEF (Straits Exchange Foundation) certification, then ARATS (Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits) verification, then filing at the provincial notary association of the PRC province where the WFOE is registered. Apostille must not be added and consular legalization in a third country must not be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Company Registration Extract) of the Taiwan corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs, Commercial Registration Information System
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Non-Hague source: Taiwan notarization, SEF certification, ARATS verification, then provincial notary association cross-check. For source documents issued in an Apostille Convention state, a single Apostille by the competent authority would be sufficient and would exclude consular legalization; the two routes are mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution / Power of Attorney authorizing the WFOE formation and the designated incorporation representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Taiwan corporate shareholder, notarized before a Taiwan Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan cross-strait authentication chain: notarization, SEF certification, ARATS verification, provincial notary association authentication, no apostille and no sequential consular legalization. If the issuer were in a Hague member state, an apostille would be the sole acceptable authentication.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association of the Taiwan corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs certified extract
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan non-Hague route: notarization, SEF certification, ARATS verification, and filing at the PRC district notary association for the WFOE place of registration; do not combine Apostille with consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Taiwan corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan issuing bank, with notarized authorized-signatory signature
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Taiwan source: notarize the bank officer signature before a Taiwan notary, then SEF certification, ARATS verification, and provincial notary association authentication before use by PRC counsel and bank. Apostille applies only to documents from Hague member states; for non-members use the consular/cross-strait legalization chain only.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening must cover each UBO, legal representative, director, officer and authorized signatory against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list, UN Security Council Consolidated Lists, PRC prohibited/unreliable entity lists, PRC terrorist organization designations, FATF public statements, EU and UK equivalents, and Taiwan domestic sanctions lists. PEP identification must include political influence persons, state-owned enterprise senior personnel, their family members and close associates, triggering enhanced due diligence, independent source-of-funds verification and senior-management approval. Adverse media, negative news, sanctions-related jurisdiction exposure, dual-use or export-control red flags, and transactions involving Iran, North Korea, Syria, Russia or Crimea must be escalated. Continuous monitoring is required throughout pre-incorporation and for the life of the banking relationship, especially because payment rails include documentary letters of credit and SWIFT wire transfers for green coffee import distribution.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Self-Service Clearance and Registration Portal, operated by the Municipal Administration for Market Regulation at the WFOE place of registration
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A WFOE legal name must be in simplified Chinese and follow the four-tier structure: administrative division, distinctive trade name, industry or business scope descriptor, and statutory entity-form suffix. For the green-coffee import and distribution business the industry token should refer to wholesale agricultural products or coffee beans corresponding to ISIC 4631/NAICS 424490. English names are ancillary business identification and cannot replace the Chinese legal name. A foreign brand may be phonetically transliterated into simplified Chinese; traditional Chinese characters and all-English registrations are not accepted for the WFOE legal name.

stage_1.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If SAMR rejects the proposed name, the applicant must first request a written rejection notice citing the legal basis. Within 15 days from receipt, local counsel should file an administrative reconsideration application with the immediately superior market supervision administration, attaching the name pre-clearance result, the intended ISIC/NAICS business-scope text, the proposed transliteration, and any advance written approval from the People's Bank of China, banking, securities, insurance, or State Council authority where a sensitive token is used. The reviewing authority must respond within 15 working days; if the rejection is upheld, the applicant may initiate an administrative lawsuit in the competent People's Court within 6 months, or promptly re-file a new name using a different distinctive token to avoid losing the business pipeline.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act of the Republic of China (Taiwan), as amended, applicable sections include Article 1 (limited company definition), Article 6 (registration requirement), Article 12 (change of registered office), Article 101 (subscription of capital), Article 108 (powers and duties of directors), Article 113 (application of company provisions to limited companies) and Article 204 (board meeting notice); read together with the Foreign Investment Act, Articles 5 and 10, the Enforcement Rules for Foreign Investment Permission, and the Central Bank of China Control of Foreign Exchange Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taipei, acting through the Company and Commercial Registration One-Stop Service; pre-clearance authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of Establishment of a Limited Liability Company filed via the Ministry of Economic Affairs One-Stop Company and Business Registration Portal; upon approval the authority issues the Company Registration Certificate and assigns a Unified Business Number.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is mandated by the Companies Act of Taiwan; however, the Investment Commission will require actual remittance of the approved capital from the foreign parent to a Taiwanese NT-dollar bank account, and this remittance must be evidenced by a foreign exchange settlement certificate at the time of incorporation. There is no blocked escrow account requirement, but the funds must remain in the company account and be backed by the capital remittance certificate issued by the designated foreign exchange bank; failure to remit within three months of the Investment Commission approval will cause the permission to lapse unless an extension is sought.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] INCORPORATED AS A LIMITED COMPANY (WFOE) UNDER THE COMPANIES ACT OF TAIWAN. I. CONVENING AND QUORUM: The Board of Directors of [Company Name] (Taiwan WFOE) held its first meeting this day at the registered address, with all appointed directors participating in person or by authenticated proxy, and the convening notice having been unanimously waived by the directors pursuant to Article 204 of the Taiwan Companies Act. The Chairperson declared that a lawful quorum existed and that the Board was competent to transact business. II. ADOPTION OF REGISTERED OFFICE: RESOLVED, that the registered office and principal place of business of the Company shall be located at [complete address], Taiwan, and that the Company Secretary shall file the registered office particulars with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and record any subsequent change in accordance with Article 12 of the Companies Act. III. SUBSCRIPTION AND ALLOTMENT OF SHARE CAPITAL: RESOLVED, that the Company's initial paid-up capital of TWD [amount], divided into [number] ordinary shares of TWD [par value] each, be fully subscribed and allotted to the sole corporate shareholder, [Parent Name], a limited company organized under the laws of the People's Republic of China. The Board directs that the subscribed capital be remitted from abroad through the foreign exchange bank and deposited into the Company's NT-dollar account at [Bank] in Taiwan in strict compliance with the Foreign Investment Act and the Central Bank's Foreign Exchange Regulations. IV. BANKING AND SIGNATORY AUTHORIZATION: RESOLVED, that [Bank], branch [number], be and is hereby appointed as the Company's principal bank and that the following authorised signatories are now approved: Director [Name] and Manager [Name] as joint signatories for all wire transfers above TWD [threshold], and the Company Secretary as sole signatory for administrative payments below TWD [threshold]. The Board adopts the use of SWIFT wire transfers and documentary letters of credit for the importation of green arabica coffee, and all such instruments must evidence the Company as account party. V. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: RESOLVED, that [Name] be and hereby is appointed as General Manager and statutory representative; [Name] be appointed Chief Financial Officer; and [Name] be appointed Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, each to serve until the next annual general meeting and to perform all obligations required by law, including filing statutory returns, maintaining the shareholder register, and ensuring compliance with the Companies Act and all industrial licensing statutes. VI. ADOPTION OF BUSINESS SCOPE: RESOLVED, that the Company's business scope be limited to ISIC 4631, being the worldwide sourcing, sea-container importation, grading, warehousing and wholesale distribution of single-origin specialty green coffee beans, all transactions to be conducted under internationally recognised contracts and with due regard to food safety and plant quarantine requirements. VII. GENERAL: RESOLVED, that the Chairperson and the Company Secretary are jointly authorised to take all necessary actions, execute all documents, and obtain all government permits required to complete incorporation, and any prior acts taken by any promoter are hereby ratified. ADOPTED unanimously this [date], at [city].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investment Permission and Name Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs, Taipei, Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an electronic application to the Investment Commission's Integrated Foreign Investment Application portal. Include the parent company's establishment certificate, a detailed English business plan for the importation and wholesale distribution of single-origin specialty green coffee beans, the proposed capital amount, source-of-funds evidence, and the intended Taiwan registered office address. The Investment Commission will perform national security, public order and source-of-funds screening, and upon clearance will issue a Foreign Investment Approval Letter and a Capital Remittance Certification Form. In parallel, reserve the WFOE name through the MOEA Company Name Reservation System, which has a six-month validity. If the Commission issues a query, the applicant has 30 days to submit supplementary documents; if the application is denied, administrative appeal may be lodged with the Executive Yuan within 30 days of service.
required_dossiers: Electronic application form for foreign investment permission
Certificate of incorporation of the Chinese parent company
Notarized articles of association of the parent company
Business plan and projected green coffee import schedule
Bank reference and lawful source-of-funds statement
Name reservation certificate for the WFOE
Power of attorney appointing the Taiwan statutory representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the investment application is queried or suspended, the Investment Commission will issue a written query; the applicant may cure by filing a supplementary letter with the requested evidence within 30 days of receipt. If the application is rejected, the applicant may pursue administrative appeal to the Executive Yuan within 30 days of service of the rejection decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Remittance and Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan), Foreign Exchange Department, acting through an authorised foreign exchange bank in Taiwan
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the Foreign Investment Approval Letter to a designated foreign exchange bank and open an NT-dollar current deposit account and a foreign currency account for the WFOE. Instruct the parent company to remit the approved capital from overseas using foreign exchange purpose code 4520 for investment capital remittance. The bank will verify the approval letter, the Taiwan statutory representative's passport or national identity document, and will complete the customer due diligence and anti-money laundering evaluation. Upon receipt, the bank will issue a foreign exchange settlement certificate and a capital remittance transaction record, which must be preserved as part of the incorporation dossier. The capital must not be spent until the company has been registered, and any delay beyond the three-month remittance window requires a prior extension application to the Investment Commission.
required_dossiers: Investment Commission Approval Letter
Board resolution authorising the bank account and signatories
Passport or national ID of the Taiwan statutory representative
Parent company bank details and certificate of deposit
Completed know-your-customer and anti-money-laundering forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank identifies a deficiency in documents or AML concerns, the bank will require corrected or supplementary information in writing. If the remittance is not completed within the three-month validity period, submit a written extension application to the Investment Commission before the expiry date; otherwise the approval lapses and a fresh application is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Filing with the Ministry of Economic Affairs
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, through the Company and Commercial Registration One-Stop Online Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation for a limited liability company with a sole foreign corporate shareholder. Complete the Application for Registration of Establishment of a Limited Company on the MOEA One-Stop Portal, upload the electronic signatures of all shareholders, and attach the name reservation certificate, capital remittance certificate, foreign exchange settlement certificate, proof of registered office, and the written consent of the directors and statutory officers. The MOEA will examine the company name, verify the paid-in capital against the bank certificate, confirm the Taiwan address, and issue the Company Registration Certificate and Unified Business Number. The registry entry is published in the MOEA company database. If the filing is queried, the applicant has 15 days to correct; if rejected, the applicant may file an administrative appeal within 30 days.
required_dossiers: Articles of Incorporation signed by all shareholders
Company name reservation certificate
Capital remittance certificate and foreign exchange settlement certificate
Consent to use of registered office address
Consent letters of the directors, general manager, and company secretary
Shareholder register and director appointment list
Application for company registration and unified business number
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a correction notice, the applicant has 15 days to remedy and resubmit. If the application is rejected, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Executive Yuan within 30 days of service, or resubmit a fully cured application after determining the reasons stated in the rejection notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, Business Registration and Customs Importer Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the jurisdiction of the registered office (for Taipei: National Taxation Bureau of Taipei); Customs Administration, Ministry of Finance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the Company Registration Certificate and Unified Business Number, apply to the National Taxation Bureau for profit-seeking enterprise tax registration, business tax registration, and the issuance of uniform invoices. The tax bureau will register the WFOE for value-added tax and corporate income tax, and will approve the company's uniform invoice system once the company seal and accounting controls are verified. Simultaneously, register the WFOE as a customs importer with the Ministry of Finance Customs Administration so that green coffee container import declarations can be lodged electronically. The WFOE must also apply for a corporate seal card and complete the employer registration with the Ministry of Labor. If filing is delayed, voluntary correction may avoid monetary penalties; any suspension notice must be addressed within 10 days.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate and Unified Business Number
Business tax registration application form
Certificate of corporate seal registration
Lease contract or ownership deed for the Taiwan premises
Identification of the statutory representative and chief financial officer
Uniform invoice request and electronic invoice equipment confirmation
Customs importer registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax bureau suspends registration, it will issue a formal notice specifying the missing documents; the applicant may cure by filing a supplementary declaration within 10 days of receipt. If the registration is rejected, the applicant may apply for reconsideration to the same tax bureau within 30 days and thereafter seek administrative litigation before the Administrative Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Food Business, Plant Quarantine, Environmental and Fire Permit Applications
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA), Bureau of Animal and Plant Health Inspection and Quarantine (BAPHIQ), Environmental Protection Administration, and the local municipal Fire Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before the first importation of green coffee beans, register the WFOE on the TFDA Food Registration Platform and obtain the Food Business Registration Certificate. Apply to BAPHIQ for a plant quarantine import permit for every consignment of unroasted green coffee beans, attaching the phytosanitary certificate issued by the exporting country; the shipment will be subject to border quarantine inspection. If the WFOE uses a warehouse in an industrial zone, file the appropriate environmental registration with the local EPA authority; if the warehouse floor area exceeds 300 square metres, submit a Fire Safety Management Plan and obtain a Fire Safety Equipment Inspection Certificate from the local fire department. No full Environmental Impact Assessment report is required for a pure wholesale distribution warehouse, but any future roasting, grinding or large-scale cold storage installation will require a separate tiered EIA review.
required_dossiers: TFDA food business registration application form
BAPHIQ plant import quarantine application form for each shipment
Phytosanitary certificate issued by the coffee-exporting country
Warehouse lease or ownership document and layout plan
Fire safety equipment inspection declaration
Environmental registration form for warehouse operation where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If BAPHIQ detains a green coffee shipment for phytosanitary reasons, the applicant may submit an immediate treatment proposal or request a sampling re-inspection within 15 days. If the fire department refuses the safety certificate, the operator must implement the inspector's corrective actions and request re-inspection within 30 days; continued non-compliance may result in a fine and suspension of the food business registration. For environmental registration queries, a rectification plan must be submitted within 30 days of the notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs; Taiwan Food and Drug Administration for food operator licensing; Bureau of Animal and Plant Health Inspection and Quarantine for green coffee phytosanitary clearance; Industrial Development Administration of MOEA for any future processing facility; local municipal fire and environmental protection departments
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Business Registration Certificate under the Taiwan Food Safety and Sanitation Act; Plant Import Quarantine Permit for Unroasted Green Coffee; Customs Importer and Exporter Registration; Warehouse Fire Safety and Public Safety Inspection Certificate; Business Registration certificate for the warehousing premises

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration, Executive Yuan, implemented by the local municipal environmental protection bureau
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category IV - Environmental Registration (low-impact wholesale warehousing); Exempt from a Full Environmental Impact Assessment Report provided there is no roasting, grinding, pulping, or high-density cold storage; if the site is later converted into a coffee processing facility, a Tier 2 or Tier 3 EIA audit will apply.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For a pure green coffee bean wholesale warehouse there is no process wastewater discharge; if any washing, humidification, or cooling water is released, compliance with Taiwan EPA effluent standards is mandatory: pH between 6 and 9, biochemical oxygen demand not exceeding 20 mg/L, chemical oxygen demand not exceeding 60 mg/L, and suspended solids not exceeding 30 mg/L. Volatile organic compound emissions from any equipment must not exceed 0.5 kg/day, and all refrigerants must be CFC-free and HCFC-free. Coffee dust in the working and storage environment must be kept below the workplace respirable dust standard of 0.2 mg/m³, and any pesticide-contaminated bagging waste must be classified, manifested, and disposed of through an approved hazardous waste contractor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil defense and occupational clearance requires a Fire Safety Equipment Inspection Certificate issued by the local fire department, renewed annually, and a Fire Safety Management Plan for any warehouse over 300 square metres, including certified emergency lighting, fire extinguishers, clear aisle access and a named fire-safety manager. The building must have a lawful occupancy permit confirming structural load and fire resistance for warehousing use. Under the Occupational Safety and Health Act, the WFOE must also file a workplace hazard assessment and obtain a Labour Inspection and Occupational Clearance for warehouse racking, forklift operations, and manual lifting; any findings must be corrected and re-inspected within 30 days.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China (国家税务总局), operating through provincial, municipal, and county-level tax bureaus. Online portal: Electronic Tax Bureau (电子税务局) at https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn; statutory website: www.chinatax.gov.cn.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) limited liability company, the unified Unified Social Credit Code (USCC, 统一社会信用代码) is automatically allocated upon registration with the Market Regulation Administration and constitutes the primary Tax Identification Number (TIN/纳税人识别号). Within 30 days after obtaining the business license (营业执照), the WFOE must complete tax registration (税务登记暨税种认定) with the competent local tax bureau via the E-Tax Bureau portal. Required filings include: business license, articles of association, legal representative identity, foreign investor identity/certification, registered address lease or ownership certificate, and bank deposit account information. The tax bureau will then confirm applicable tax categories (CIT, VAT, stamp duty, etc.), electronify the taxpayer profile, and issue the tax registration certificate equivalently through the electronic registration system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; the CN WFOE is a Chinese resident enterprise (居民企业) subject to Enterprise Income Tax on worldwide income at the standard 25% CIT rate. It is a limited liability company with independent legal personality; pass-through eligibility does not apply. Territorial scope: Chinese source and worldwide income of the WFOE is taxable in the PRC; foreign income tax credits are available under the PRC CIT Law. Tax-Exempt Zone: none applicable by default; preferential zones (e.g., Hainan Free Trade Port, certain bonded areas) may offer reduced CIT rates or customs privileges only upon qualifying application, which is not presumed for this standard WFOE.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: PRC tax law does not provide check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections comparable to US/European regimes. Available statutory elections include: (i) VAT general taxpayer voluntary election after meeting accounting and turnover criteria (annual taxable sales > RMB 5,000,000 is compulsory; below threshold, small-scale taxpayer status is default, but voluntary general taxpayer status may be chosen with robust accounting); (ii) simplified tax collection (核定征收) for income tax in exceptional cases, subject to stringent approval and generally not available for WFOE; (iii) accelerated depreciation or specific depreciation methods under CIT; (iv) loss carryforward utilisation election (standard 5-year carryforward, with extended periods for qualifying industries); (v) foreign tax credit choice between direct and indirect credits; and (vi) VAT input credit selection for dutiable and zero-rated operations. No entity classification election is permitted for a WFOE; it is automatically a ring-fenced resident entity.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value-Added Tax) of the People's Republic of China (增值税). Standard VAT headline rate is 13% (general goods); unroasted green coffee beans falling under HS 0901 11 qualify as agricultural products and are subject to the reduced 9% VAT rate at import and domestic sale.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: All enterprises, including WFOEs, must register with the tax authority within 30 days of incorporation regardless of turnover. For VAT general taxpayer status, compulsory registration applies when annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000 (or when expected turnover exceeds that threshold); below RMB 5,000,000, small-scale taxpayer status applies with an option to elect general taxpayer treatment on fulfilling accounting/control requirements.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China has implemented the National Fully Digital Electronic Invoice (全电发票) regime, integrated with the Golden Tax Phase IV system. All VAT invoices (General and Special) must be issued through the official Electronic Invoice Platform, encrypted with taxpayer UKeys, and transmitted in real time to the STA database. For customs and export transactions, electronic export declarations and digital clearance are mandatory; no physical stamping is applied. The system automatically reconciles invoice data, customs data, and foreign exchange receipts, creating a real-time fiscal audit trail for indirect taxation and export refunds.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: An export of goods from the PRC is eligible for VAT zero-rating (0% VAT with refund of input VAT) if: (i) the seller is a registered VAT general taxpayer and a Foreign Trade Operator registered with the Ministry of Commerce and Customs; (ii) the goods are physically exported and declared to Customs with an approved export declaration; (iii) the sale is a genuine commercial export to an overseas buyer (including excluded cross-border transactions with Taiwan only where permitted under PRC Cross-Strait trade instruments; mainland WFOEs exporting directly to Taiwan follow standard export procedures); (iv) the exporter has obtained and maintained an export tax refund category (出口退（免）税企业管理类别); and (v) the export proceeds are repatriated to China within the statutory period. For re-export of imported green coffee beans, any import VAT paid may be refunded after satisfying the same substantive requirements, subject to the 'examination of export difficulties' exception and no prior processing in unrestricted domestic consumption.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration Form (出口货物报关单), including the customs-assigned export record number
Commercial Invoice (商业发票), separately stating export price, HS code (0901 11), and trade terms
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (海运提单 / 航空运单) evidencing actual shipment from a PRC port
Export Proceeds Collection Certificate / Bank Inward Remittance Receipt (出口收汇凭证/银行收汇水单), proving foreign currency repatriation to the WFOE's designated bank account
VAT Special Invoice (增值税专用发票) or Customs Import VAT Special Payment Book / Import Duty Special Payment Book (海关进口增值税专用缴款书) for the re-exported imported goods
Export Sales Contract (出口销售合同) with the overseas buyer
Customs/Quarantine certificates for green coffee beans (植物检疫证书及原产地证明), where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA uses Golden Tax Phase IV and cross-agency data analytics (customs declarations, invoice issuance, foreign exchange receipts, and export manifest) to identify fraudulent export VAT refunds. In case of false export declarations, forged documentation, or failure to meet the FX repatriation deadline, the tax authority denies or claws back the refunded VAT, imposes a penalty of 0.5 to 5 times the tax amount involved, levies late-payment surcharges (0.05% per day), downgrades the exporter's risk classification, and suspends or revokes export tax refund status. Serious fraud constitutes the criminal offence of export tax fraud under Article 204 of the PRC Criminal Law (punishable by imprisonment up to life and fines), and may also trigger customs smuggling charges under the PRC Customs Law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC) acting through the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Renminbi is fully convertible for bona fide current account transactions, including the import of green coffee beans and related logistics costs, subject to documentary verification by a licensed Chinese bank. Capital account items remain subject to prior SAFE registration and supervision; a WFOE receives foreign equity investment through the FDI capital account mechanism after obtaining SAFE's Foreign Direct Investment Registration and the bank-issued e-certificate. Profit remittance by a WFOE is treated as a current account transaction and is legally permissible once the enterprise has completed annual audit, tax clearance, and the bank has verified audited financial statements, the foreign exchange settlement account records, and a board or shareholders' resolution approving the distribution. Cross-strait Taiwan investor participation triggers additional beneficial ownership and source-of-funds scrutiny but does not alter the underlying classification.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE trade-monitoring regulations, export proceeds for goods must be repatriated into a domestic designated foreign exchange settlement account within the time limit agreed by the bank, usually not exceeding 90 days from the date of customs export declaration. There is no mandatory statutory conversion ratio; an exporter may voluntarily settle into RMB or retain the proceeds in a foreign currency settlement account, provided the inflows reconcile with customs declared values and the SAFE Trade Monitoring System. The exporter must report the receipt with the correct trade purpose code and maintain supporting customs declarations, commercial invoices, bills of lading, and bank receipts to satisfy the verification and write-off procedures. For this WFOE, the primary business is importation rather than export, so the compliance focus is import-payment verification and outward remittance controls, while any incidental sample or re-export of green coffee beans would be subject to the 90-day repatriation norm.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Account plus RMB basic operating account and foreign exchange settlement account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Foreign Exchange Account and RMB general settlement account
Cross-border integrated treasury account with FDI capital sub-ledger and trade settlement rails

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for core treasury operations. Offshore digital EMI platforms and cross-border payment fintechs (e.g., Airwallex, Payoneer, PingPong) are acceptable only as auxiliary collection or disbursement channels for small-value, platform-driven cross-border trade settlements, and cannot replace a licensed Chinese domestic bank for FDI capital holding, SAFE trade verification, RMB settlement, corporate income tax compliance, or documentary letter of credit issuance. Any use must be structured as a secondary receivable-payment layer beneath a primary domestic bank account, with all funds ultimately repatriated to the WFOE's own China-based settlement account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandatory for corporate account opening at tier-1 domestic banks in China, particularly for an FDI capital account and foreign exchange settlement account. At least one director or an individually authorized signatory with power of attorney must attend a face-to-face interview at the bank branch where the account is domiciled; authorized signatories and ultimate beneficial owners are subject to individual KYC interviews, and the bank must verify original corporate chops, the business license, SAFE registration certificate, and board resolutions. Remote video opening may be permitted under limited dual-signatory and counter-interview conditions for the operational RMB account after the entity has obtained a local office, staff records, and financial history; however, the FDI capital account and any account involving cross-border proceeds will require in-person verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner is a Taiwan-resident individual or Taiwan-registered entity, creating cross-strait political exposure and enhanced due diligence concern.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prepare, in a single electronic pack: Taiwan Corporate Registration / establishment certificate, Chinese business license and company constitution, complete corporate beneficial ownership chain, domestic and Taiwan passport or identity documents, source-of-wealth statement from bank or investment brokerage, audited financials for the past three years, a clear board resolution designating the WFOE bank signatories, and documentary evidence that the coffee bean business is a civilian food commodity with no dual-use or strategic goods exposure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sourcing of green coffee beans from countries perceived as higher-risk or subject to intensified sanctions and AML screening.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Assemble country-of-origin certificates, phytosanitary and health certificates from the exporting port, graded green coffee contract and proforma invoice, full set of clean-on-board ocean bills of lading, container packing list, import customs declaration forms, and a completed supplier AML/KYC questionnaire; retain a live UN/OFAC/PRC sanctions-screening report for every supplier, vessel, and intermediary to evidence legitimate agricultural trade.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discrepancy between stated operational revenue expectations and the deployed trade volumes, triggering a suspicious transaction enquiry.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintain a reconciled treasury file containing signed purchase orders with international suppliers, LC terms or SWIFT MT103 records, customs duty and VAT payment certificates, warehouse in-bound records, quality inspection reports, domestic sales agreements or distribution contracts, and monthly management accounts; all documentation should be harmonized with the declared ISIC 4631 coffee wholesaling scope and cross-matching invoices, bills of lading, and proof-of-payment.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived lack of corporate substance, such as a WFOE with no dedicated office or staff beyond nominal directors.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a valid lease agreement for a physical China-based office, photos/video of the premises with signage, employee payroll and local social insurance contribution records, food dealer or import business license amendments if applicable, utility bills, and third-party confirmation of a proven supply-chain office; include bank references from the investor's principal financial institution and annual corporate filings to demonstrate real business activity beyond the bank's commercial register.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity subscription and paid-in capital shall be routed by SWIFT MT103 wire from the Taiwan parent or investing shareholder to the WFOE's SAFE-registered FDI capital foreign exchange account at the chosen domestic bank. The remittance must be accompanied by a purpose declaration consistent with SAFE's FDI code for inward equity investment; the receiving bank will credit the account only after verifying the SAFE e-foreign-direct-investment registration certificate, board resolution, formation and business license of the WFOE, and the investor's KYC/passport pack. On the same day of credited arrival and after the bank's capital-golden term monitoring, the WFOE may convert into RMB under the bank's foreign exchange settlement system, subject to payment of the applicable RMB and USD interbank exchange price and reporting under the capital project monitoring system. The funds can be released to fund working capital for green coffee inventory, logistics, and operating expenditure only after providing a lawful use-circumstances declaration and, if required, the bank's invoice-level verification for payment in support of import costs.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Disbursements for the import of specialty green coffee bean containers and related ocean or air logistics shall be executed via (i) SWIFT MT103 direct telegraphic transfer from the WFOE's foreign exchange settlement account to the overseas supplier, or (ii) an irrevocable documentary commercial letter of credit (LC) issued by the WFOE's Chinese bank, payable at sight or on a 90-day usance basis. Both methods require submission to the issuing bank of the commercial invoice, full set of bills of lading, phytosanitary certificate, certificate of origin, packing list, and, in the case of LC, a compliant presentation through the negotiating bank. For outward remittances, the WFOE must declare the trade purpose code for goods imports and the bank will perform matching against the customs import data, ensuring the amount, currency, and beneficiary are consistent with the underlying trade contract; no foreign-exchange purchase for these payments is available without the relevant import documents, and any advance payment exceeding the bank's threshold requires the commercial contract and, where necessary, a bank guarantee from the supplier.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: SAFE-approved onshore RMB/USD FX forwards with documentary trade-background verification, used to lock the imported green coffee cost against USD invoice exposure

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed offshore through the Taiwan treasury center or an eligible offshore financial institution, subject to cross-strait remittance limitations and internal corporate hedging policy, applicable only for macro-hedge of non-RMB settlement exposure

Cross-currency swaps between RMB and USD under the bank's derivative framework for hedging long-tenor working capital and trade financing interest rate and currency risk, permissible only when the underlying exposure is evidenced by trade receivables, inventory, or capital-flow obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' meeting minutes and financial statements filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA) – Company Registration Central Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: AGM within 6 months after fiscal year-end; financial statements filed with MOEA within 15 days after the meeting (calendar-year WFOE: AGM by June 30; filing by July 15)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Responsible person liable to fines under Company Act for failure to convene AGM or submit financial statements; MOEA may order rectification, and continuing non-compliance may result in repeated administrative fines.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEAIC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the close of the fiscal year (calendar-year WFOE: by June 30)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate filing may trigger a corrective order and administrative fine under the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals; prolonged non-filing can result in revocation of the foreign-investment approval.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-seeking Enterprise Income Tax (CIT) Annual Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau, Ministry of Finance (ROC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: May 1 through May 31 following the taxable year for calendar-year companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 3% of the unreported tax amount for each 2-month period, up to 15%; unresolved overdue amounts are subject to surcharge and compulsory collection under the Tax Collection Act.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory CPA audit under Taiwan Company Act Article 20 and MOEA order where paid-in capital exceeds NT$30,000,000 (approx. US$1,000,000), or where otherwise required by MOEA rules; small WFOEs below the threshold may file audited or unaudited financial statements depending on tax-review requirements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan-IFRS as endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission for public companies; non-public WFOE generally applies ROC Business Entity Accounting Law and TFRS for SMEs (converged with IFRS principles).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan does not impose a separate annual UBO confirmation return for non-financial WFOEs; however, the company must maintain an up-to-date shareholder register, record all share transfers, and obtain Investment Commission approval for any change in foreign-ownership structure. The board must present a report of share transfers and register updates to the annual shareholders' meeting.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$300 - US$1,000 (annual registered address and corporate secretarial agent service, excluding government fees)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$2,000 - US$6,000 (annual CPA audit for a small specialty coffee wholesale importer, excluding tax filing fees)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday for green coffee wholesale distribution. Applicable reliefs include: (i) 10-year tax loss carryforward; (ii) foreign income tax credit; (iii) limited investment tax credits for approved automation and R&D; (iv) deduction of arm's-length interest and royalties. A coffee import WFOE typically bears a 20% effective CIT rate on assessable income, plus a 5% retained earnings surtax on undistributed earnings, making the combined burden on distributed profits approximately 25% before shareholder-level withholding.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (Form 15 series) filed electronically via the Ministry of Finance electronic tax filing system (tax.nat.gov.tw) or by registered mail to the National Taxation Bureau of the relevant jurisdiction.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement return; calendar-year taxpayers also make a statutory provisional tax payment by 30 September of the current year. No separate quarterly CIT filing applies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Final return due on or before 31 May of the year following the taxable year; for enterprises adopting a special accounting year, due within five months after the close of the taxable year. Provisional tax is due by 30 September for calendar-year enterprises.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross sales of specialty green coffee beans from container wholesale distribution, including invoiced export and domestic sales, reduced by sales returns and allowances.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report on an accrual basis; reconcile to documentary letter of credit drawdowns and SWIFT inward remittances; retain bills of lading, customs entries, and warehouse receipts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Green bean purchase cost, ocean freight, insurance, customs duty, inland freight, inspection, and warehousing costs; opening and closing inventory adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All related-party purchases from the PRC parent must be supported by contemporaneous transfer pricing documents with CIF Taiwan adjustment; include LC fees and reject unsubstantiated rebates.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Salaries, rent, utilities, depreciation, logistics, quality control, insurance, brokerage commissions, and administrative expenses attributable to Taiwan operations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses must be incurred in Taiwan or supported by written contracts evidencing actual services; related-party management fees are deductible only at arm's length and after correct withholding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign exchange gains and losses, interest income, financing costs, and incidental gains or losses outside the main trading activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest and royalty payments to the PRC parent are deductible only if withholding tax has been correctly applied and beneficial-ownership documentation is maintained.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Assessable income less deductible expenses and prior-year tax losses under Article 39 of the Income Tax Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 10-year loss carryforward; a certified public accountant audit report is recommended to preserve the loss carryforward claim.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit-seeking enterprise income tax computed at 20% of taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compare with the Alternative Minimum Tax in Box 15; AMT applies at 12% to basic income exceeding NT$500,000 where relevant.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 18 - Tax Credits and Withholding Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign income tax credit, investment tax credit, and prior withholding credits; net tax payable after credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach tax residence certificates or foreign tax payment evidence; the foreign tax credit is limited to the Taiwan tax attributable to the foreign-source coffee trading income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: a surcharge of 3% of the assessed tax per month, up to a maximum of 9%, where the return is filed after the deadline but before discovery. Non-filing after a tax authority notice triggers estimated assessment plus the same surcharge. Late payment: a surcharge of 1% per two days, up to 15%, plus overdue interest at the postal savings rate. Understatement: Article 110 of the Income Tax Act imposes a fine of up to 3 times the underpaid tax in fraudulent cases, with criminal liability under the Tax Collection Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 21% withholding tax on dividends distributed by the Taiwan WFOE to a non-resident corporate shareholder. Mainland Chinese shareholders cannot claim treaty relief because the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement, signed in 2015, has not entered into force; the 21% statutory rate applies. Undistributed earnings are also subject to a 5% retained earnings surtax at the corporate level.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: For a shareholder resident in a jurisdiction with an effective Taiwan tax treaty, the WFOE must apply to the National Taxation Bureau before or at the time of distribution, attaching: (i) an original Certificate of Residence issued by the home jurisdiction tax authority; (ii) a beneficial-ownership declaration; (iii) evidence of qualifying shareholding, typically 10% to 25%; and (iv) the applicable treaty provision. Upon approval, the reduced withholding rate, commonly 5% to 10%, applies. If excess withholding has been collected, a refund claim may be filed within five years. For PRC mainland shareholders, no treaty-based reduction is currently available.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates for a Taiwan WFOE remitting funds overseas: 15% for interest on debt to a non-resident corporate lender, or 20% for short-term commercial paper; 20% for royalties on IP licenses. Under effective Taiwan tax treaties, royalties and interest are commonly capped at 10%. The same Certificate of Residence and beneficial-ownership procedures govern treaty rate application; failure to withhold exposes the Taiwan payer to penalties of 10% to 30% of the unwithheld tax under Article 114 of the Income Tax Act.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Transfer Pricing Report, or Local File, applies where aggregate controlled transactions reach NT$200 million or more in a taxable year. Master File is required when the multinational group's consolidated global revenue exceeds NT$30 billion and the Taiwan entity meets the Local File threshold. Country-by-Country Report is required when group consolidated revenue exceeds NT$27 billion. Below the thresholds, contemporaneous documentation and an arm's-length range analysis for the green coffee distribution margin are strongly recommended.
